hook: Gold can move here without moving there.

storyboard.visual: Gold bars float into frame, wrapped by a cool-blue currency ribbon.
Camera moves through the ribbon; the bar reflects two distinct light sources.
Three abstract markers assemble around the bar: global gold, dollar, rupee.
Currency ribbon tightens gently around the gold reflection.
storyboard.copy: The rupee changes the Indian quote.

voiceover: Indian gold is not just global gold. The dollar and rupee sit in the middle. That is why MCX can move when global gold barely does. BhaavBrief.
caption: MCX gold reflects global gold, the dollar, and USD/INR—not one price alone. Educational data, not investment advice.
approval_note: Evergreen education concept. Any figures added later must be source-verified before human approval.
